title: Characterization of Safe Stabilization and Control Lyapunov-Barrier Functions via Zubov Equation Formulation
summary: Design and analysis of stabilizing controllers with safety guarantees for nonlinear systems have received considerable attention in recent years. Control Lyapunov-barrier functions (CLBFs) provide a powerful framework for simultaneously ensuring stability and safety; however, their construction for nonlinear systems remains challenging.
